pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with rounded corners. Edges show smooth pixel gradients rather than sharp, jagged transitions. Patch size is relatively uniform across the mid-flank with slight elongation observed as they transition toward the neck base.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pathway thickness is relatively wide and stable, though slightly constricted at specific intersection nodes.
